purpose: explicitly opted-in pytest scenario comparison; not a migration
fixture_changes: Application lifecycle belongs to pytest fixtures; manual stop/teardown/assert_no_failures calls removed.
Configuration PUT helper synthetic status-200 assertions replaced by successful real fixture-domain installs. API response assertions remain unchanged.

The asynchronous workflow fixture uses the production job wait timer for a real long-running operation; the original repeated file-read loop reaches the 1000-suspension limit before real heartbeat staleness can occur.
known_coupling: Scenario actions and expectations use production tool/API contracts and published event fields; fixture utilities seed inputs and read persisted outputs.
execution_differences: Function-scoped application roots and event loops in one pytest process, rather than a fresh supervised worker and filtered environment for every scenario.
Ordinary assertions stop at the first failure; soft assertion aggregation is not implemented.
Hard process timeout/crash handling and manual CI governance enforcement are not reproduced by the experiment.

application_boundaries.file_edits: Production FileWrite tool dispatch and tool_invoked sink events, plus actual filesystem outputs.
application_boundaries.task_state: GET /api/tasks/{task_id} through the real application ASGI TestClient.
application_boundaries.scheduler: GET /api/status, with a real managed scheduled workflow as positive control.
application_boundaries.heartbeat_staleness: Production WorkflowRun status operation after real elapsed time; fixed product threshold currently 60 seconds, bounded by a 90-second observation timeout.
application_boundaries.fixture_inputs: Files and deliberate configuration-corruption fixtures are seeded as inputs; actual operations and assertions use production services/results.

expected_results: passed: real app after exception in same worker
failed: intentional native worker abort, cleanup unconfirmed
passed: real app in replacement worker
crash_profile.platform: Native SIGABRT probe tested on Linux; core dumps disabled in the fault worker.
